visual_refs: existing TAKY badge art + stable asset slots
game collection / codex interaction patterns only
official Pokédex: number-first browsing + multi-filter discovery
Genshin Archive/HoYoWiki: category archive + detail review
authority.rule: Use game-codex information architecture and interaction patterns without copying another game's branded visual design. Existing TAKY artwork/IDs/SHA remain authoritative.

screens.interaction_rule: 보기(view mode)는 묶는 기준, 정렬(sort)은 묶음 내부/전체 순서 기준으로 분리한다.
screens.nature_progress: show earned/total inside each nature filter chip

tile_contract.art_resolution: asset_slot_id -> binding manifest current_art; UI must not hardcode versioned file bytes
forbidden: infer earned state from art status

detail_contract.story_source: core_detail + story_authority from art binding manifest; obtain condition comes from badge logic catalog, not image prompt
detail_contract.profile_character: separate optional UI overlay; never becomes part of badge artwork identity

tier_contract.art_independence: tier/rim/star changes never replace or mutate common badge art file

runtime_invariants: art replacement changes only current_art bytes + sha256 + revision/source lineage
badge logic/condition/history are independent from art quality status
CURRENT_APPROVED/CURRENT_CANDIDATE/CURRENT_FUTURE_UPDATE are asset-quality governance states, not learner ownership states
no missing image fallback may create new art automatically
game-codex UI changes must not mutate badge award logic
SECRET mystery masking is presentation-only and never changes stored metadata
third-party game visual branding/assets are never copied
view mode and sort are independent presentation state; neither mutates badge metadata or award state
nature progress counts and acquisition summary are derived from badge runtime ledger only; never invented

design_direction.copy_rule: TAKY terminology only; no third-party branded visual imitation

GOAL_ACHIEVEMENT.description: 끝까지 완료하거나 목표 지점에 도달한 경험

FOCUS_IMMERSION.description: 집중을 유지하거나 흐름에 깊게 들어간 경험

ERROR_LEARNING.description: 실수를 발견하고 다시 보고 고친 경험

PROBLEM_SOLVING.description: 막힘을 풀거나 도움·전략을 활용해 해결한 경험

EXTRA_GROWTH.description: 요구 이상으로 확장하거나 이해·설명·성장을 보여준 경험

nature_contract.primary_nature: exactly one primary classification per badge
nature_contract.nature_tags: zero or more secondary behavior tags
nature_contract.source: badge meaning/trigger semantics; independent from art category and tier
nature_contract.invariant: Changing nature classification never changes badge_id, visual_id, asset_slot_id, art SHA, ownership, tier, or award history
